messages.text: I still have no answer about the wrong psu that was shipped with my miner
I'll pull your orders and see what's on file.
Handed to the team · Wrong part shipped, packing error: only the team can send the replacement PSU.

I'm sorry, Nicholas. You shouldn't have had to chase this.

That's the NEXUS S1 from Shop····, delivered October 22. A wrong power supply in a sealed box is our packing error, so you keep the miner, nothing goes back.

I've put it in front of the team to send the correct supply. They're offline now and pick it up Monday at 10am ET, and the answer comes to your email.

One thing that will speed it up: what does the PSU you received say on its label, voltage and connector?

Got it, Nicholas, a Mean Well LRS-200. I've added that to the note for the team so they know exactly what turned up in your box and what to send instead.

They pick it up Monday at 10am ET and you'll get the answer at (email hidden) Nothing more needed from you, and don't send anything back.

In the meantime, is the S1 running at all on that supply, or is it not powering up?
I actually had an extra mean well udp 350 laying around so I am using that with no issues

Good, that solves the immediate problem. Smart to have a spare on hand.

The question for Monday then is what you want out of it: the correct supply sent anyway so you have the right one in the box, or something else to settle it since you covered it yourself.

Which would you rather? I'll put your answer on the ticket so the team doesn't have to ask again.
If they can credit something back to my account that would be great
Handed to the team · Credit amount for a mis-shipped PSU is not mine to set; goodwill check returns i

That's on the ticket now, Nicholas: no part to send, a credit instead.

I can't set the amount myself, so the team decides that one. They pick it up Monday at 10am ET and confirm it to (email hidden), so you don't need to wait here.

For context, your Shop···· has had $200 and $50 back already, both for the shipping delay, not this. I've made clear the PSU is a separate, new issue so it's judged on its own.
